segments.he: מַתְנִי׳ הַגַּבָּאִין שֶׁנִּכְנְסוּ לְתוֹךְ הַבַּיִת, וְכֵן הַגַּנָּבִים שֶׁהֶחְזִירוּ אֶת הַכֵּלִים — נֶאֱמָנִין לוֹמַר: לֹא נָגַעְנוּ. וּבִירוּשָׁלַיִם נֶאֱמָנִין עַל הַקּוֹדֶשׁ, וּבִשְׁעַת הָרֶגֶל אַף עַל הַתְּרוּמָה.
segments.en: «MISHNA:» In the case of amei ha’aretz tax «collectors who entered a house» to collect items for a tax, «and similarly thieves who returned the vessels» they had stolen, «they are deemed credible when they say: We did not touch» the rest of the objects in the house, and those items remain pure. «And in Jerusalem» all people, even amei ha’aretz, «are deemed credible with regard to sacrificial» food throughout the year, «and during a pilgrimage Festival» they are deemed credible «even with regard to teruma.»

moves.summary: Tax collectors and returning thieves are credible; Jerusalem and Festival leniencies

positions.claim: tax collectors and thieves who returned vessels are credible to say 'we did not touch'; in Jerusalem all are credible on sacred food, and on the Festival even on teruma
